about_the_game:
Play the demo of Into the Dataswarm, a single-player puzzle game containing 24 levels and 2 intermission stages. Delve into cyberspace as Anni the cyber elf, whose goal is to rid the Corrupters. Hack and steal access keys from the Corrupters in order to unlock the escape point and dive deeper into the core of cyberspace. But watch out! Stealing their keys will make them frenzy and take drastic measures to stop you! Careful planning and movement is imperative in order to solve each of our hand-crafted levels!

More is the come in the full release! Expect more levels, more obstacles, and see to the conclusion of Anni's adventure into the swarm!

What's in the Demo?

  • 24 levels and 2 intermission stages feature the core mechanics and obstacles in the main game

  • Replay and discover some of the hidden achievements

  • Play chaotically or strategically! Figure out different ways to escape each level and optimize your clears!

  • Understand the Corrupters' behaviors and exploit them to solve challenging and dangerous levels.

  • Enjoy a sneak peek of Anni's story, as she explores the depths of the Corrupter's base of operations!

Note that this demo does not fully support controllers. Controller support will be featured in the full game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Memory: 80 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
  • Storage: 281 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Into the Dataswarm is a turn-based puzzle game inspired by Metal Gear Solid and Megaman, featuring simple, yet intricate levels to solve. Steal access keys from the Corrupters by hacking them, unlock the exit and avoid their attempts to hinder you, as you investigate a way to stop their invasion.
